name: NeFTY (Neural Field Thermal Tomography)
definition: A method for recovering a spatially varying diffusivity field αθ by minimizing a reconstruction objective J with the heat equation enforced as a hard constraint via a differentiable physics solver, using a discrete adjoint for gradient computation to avoid memory bottlenecks.
summary: NeFTY is a neural field framework for label-free 3D thermal tomography that recovers thermal diffusivity by enforcing the heat equation as a hard constraint, avoiding the gradient pathologies of soft-constrained PINNs.
